# Support

> **There is no SLA.** Intent Rebase Engine (IRE) is a personal-project
> bounded implementation. It is **not production-ready**. Support is
> best-effort and bounded by the project's current scope.

## Where to get help

For most questions, please use the public, asynchronous channels below — they
are the fastest way to reach the maintainer and the most useful for future
visitors with the same question.

1. **Read the documentation first.**
   - [README.md](../README.md) — project overview, quickstart, workspace
     crates.
   - [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md) — full documentation index.
   - [Status & Capabilities](../docs/reference/status-and-capabilities.md) —
     what is delivered, what is bounded, and what is out of scope.
   - [Capability Support Matrix](../docs/01-product/04-capability-support-matrix.md)
     — bounded support vs. production-status per capability.
   - [Test Strategy](../docs/11-quality/01-test-strategy.md) — how to run
     the local verification commands.
   - [Architecture Overview](../docs/02-architecture/01-system-overview.md)
     — system design and trust boundaries.

2. **Search existing issues.** Someone may have already asked the same
   question. Use the issue search to look for related reports.

3. **Open a new issue** with the appropriate template:
   - [Bug report](../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md)
   - [Feature request](../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md)

4. **For security issues, do not use the public issue tracker.** Follow
   [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead.

## What is **not** promised

- **No response-time SLA.** Acknowledge and triage are best effort.
- **No dedicated support channel.** There is no paid support tier, no
  private helpdesk, and no live chat.
- **No "production" guidance.** IRE is not production-ready. If your
  question is "should I run this in production?" the answer is "not
  yet" — see
  [Status & Capabilities](../docs/reference/status-and-capabilities.md).
- **No escalation path for production incidents.** This is a
  personal-project repository. The maintainer is not on call.

## Contributing fixes

If you can fix the issue yourself, please see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the
[PR template](../.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md). Small, well-scoped PRs
that include the local-verification checklist are the most likely to land
quickly.
